Subject: BrightLynk POC: impact recap + quick spotlight ask

Hi Liam / Sophie,

First — huge thanks to your team for running the POC with us over the last month. We ran the final evaluation this morning and wanted to share a short recap of the impact we saw and ask a small favor.

POC highlights (BrightLynk config -> Redwood default quantized model):
- 3.2x reduction in median inference latency (210ms -> 65ms) for conversational flows under typical load patterns.
- 42% reduction in per-token serving cost after enabling prefix caching for recurring prompts.
- Average answer relevance (internal eval) improved by 12 points on BrightLynk test prompts vs baseline.
- KV cache hit rate stabilized at ~78% for the 10k active sessions subset.

Why this matters for you: those two levers (caching + batching tweaks we walked through) map to measurable cost savings and faster UI response for customers — the metrics above were representative of the flows you highlighted during discovery.

Quick ask: would BrightLynk be comfortable with a short (15-minute) customer spotlight call and a one-line approved quote we can use in a case study? We would:
- Share a one-page impact brief internally (attached draft).
- Publish a short quote (you approve the exact wording).
- Use BrightLynk logo and link to BrightLynk website with your permission.

If helpful, Monica from our Customer Success team has a draft quote and a short template we can send over — otherwise, a single-sentence approval in an email is perfect.

Proposed windows for a 15-min call next week: Thursday 5/21 10:30–11:30 PT or 2:00–3:00 PM PT. If neither work, tell us a slot that does.

Thanks again — appreciate the partnership.

—
Rishi Malhotra
